content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway for digital products is a system that enables creators to sell their products online without relying on traditional payment platforms. This is particularly important for creators in countries where these platforms are restricted or unavailable. By using a crypto payment gateway, creators can reach a global audience and receive payments in a variety of cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin and USDT.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a crypto payment gateway for digital products typically involves a combination of tools and services, including a hosting platform, a backend logic provider, and a payment processor. For example, a creator might use GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup allows for automatic payment verification and instant product delivery, all without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators who want to sell their products online without relying on traditional payment platforms. This includes creators of ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and other digital products. By using a crypto payment gateway, these creators can reach a global audience and receive payments in a variety of cryptocurrencies, all while avoiding the high fees associated with traditional payment platforms.
Crypto payment gateways offer a 0.5% fee, compared to Gumroad's 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make a crypto payment gateway for digital products work together include a hosting platform, a backend logic provider, a payment processor, and a digital product delivery system. For example, a creator might use Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, NOWPayments for payment processing, and Google Drive for digital product delivery. This setup allows for automatic payment verification and instant product delivery, all without relying on traditional payment platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a crypto payment gateway for digital products today, creators can start by choosing a hosting platform and a backend logic provider. They can then set up a payment processor, such as NOWPayments, and integrate it with their hosting platform and backend logic provider. Finally, they can add their digital products to the system and start selling. With the right tools and services, creators can have a fully functional crypto payment gateway up and running in no time.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can use a crypto payment gateway for digital products. This involves setting up a hosting platform, a backend logic provider, and a payment processor, such as NOWPayments. With this setup, creators can receive payments in a variety of cryptocurrencies and deliver their ebooks instantly, all without relying on traditional payment platforms. NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin and USDT.
